label: Efficiency and O2 delivery lie in the ranges the cited sources support (widened after measured zebrafish)
statement_en: eta <= 0.23, oxycaloric <= 19.35 J/ml and O2 delivery Q*Ca <= 0.0187 ml O2/s (1600 mg O2 kg^-1 h^-1 at 0.06 kg) imply an aerobic ceiling of at most 0.0833 W.

hypotheses.source: Palstra AP et al. (2010) PLoS One 5:e14483, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0014483, PMC3013094, Results "Swimming economy" (MO2max at Ucrit 82.18 umol g^-1 h^-1 = 2630 mg O2 kg^-1 h^-1; 0.43 g, 28 C); Gladman NW, Askew GN (2024) J Exp Biol 227, PMC11583979 (contractile efficiency 0.37 x oxidative recovery 0.61 = 0.23); physiology/muscle.js (oxycaloric 13.54 J/mg at 0.7 ml O2 per mg). Analysis: physics/FICK-CEILING-CHECK.md section 5.
hypotheses.observation: Within the ranges its sources support (skeletal-muscle aerobic efficiency up to 0.23, Gladman and Askew 2024; O2 delivery up to the measured adult zebrafish MO2max at Ucrit, Palstra et al. 2010, scaled allometrically to 0.06 kg), the sustained aerobic ceiling at 0.06 kg is at most 0.0833 W. Version 1.0.0 said no teleost exceeds 0.0458 W; measured zebrafish (2630 mg O2 kg^-1 h^-1) exceed its delivery envelope (1350 mg O2 kg^-1 h^-1) about 2x per kg, so that wording is withdrawn. Powered flight at 10 m/s needs 1.346 W, about 16x this ceiling.

mass_kg.note: the O2-delivery bound (1600 mg O2 kg^-1 h^-1) was converted to ml O2/s for a 0.06 kg fish; at any other mass the absolute bound 0.0187 ml/s is not the one the sources give

scope.basis: measured zebrafish MO2max (Palstra 2010) scaled to 0.06 kg and skeletal-muscle efficiency (Gladman and Askew 2024), as cross-taxon transfers; scoped to those sources, not to every teleost
scope.note: Scoped to the sources named: high-performance pelagic teleosts (tunas) were not fetched and may exceed it. It bounds SUSTAINED AEROBIC power only: burst power on white-muscle stores is outside it, and that is what a flying fish is understood to use. v1.0.0 (0.0458 W, "no teleost above") was withdrawn because measured zebrafish exceeded its per-kg delivery envelope about 2x (physics/FICK-CEILING-CHECK.md).
